item.title: Jules House NW6 7QW, 9th August
item.description:
Statutory Nuisance and Fire Hazard at Jules House From our windows, we have a continuous, direct view of the illegal dumping ground your tenants are operating in the communal bin area of Jules House. As shown in the attached files the area is currently blocked by a discarded mattress, commercial cardboard, and bulk debris. This is not an occasional issue; it is a persistent, unmanaged eyesore that directly infringes upon our legal rights. Our Position and Rights: Statutory Nuisance: This continuous fly-tipping constitutes a Statutory Nuisance under Section 79 of the Environmental Protection Act 1990, creating immediate health, vermin, and pest hazards on our boundary.

Report on FixMyStreet
